Buyer Added Bid Specific Scope Of Work(SOW) Text Clause(s) Text Clause(s) This tender is being published for DEO, Dehradun Office. Outsourcing staffs will have to be supplied at bot h of the above places. It is mandatory for the bidder to attend the pre-bid meeting. Non-attendance shall lead to disqualification. It is advised to fix the minimum service charge as 3.85% for the service contract and this fact may be discl osed in the bid. Tenders having service charges less than the minimum prescribed service charge will not be considered. In this regard, the self-declaration document must be compulsorily attached along with bid. If it is not submitted by the bidder, the bid will be rejected in the technical evaluation. AVAILABILITY OF OFFICE OF SERVICE PROVIDER: An office of the Service Provider must be located in the Di strict of Consignee. DOCUMENTARY EVIDENCE TO BE SUBMITTED. A copy of the PAN Card and GST Registration must be uploaded along with the bid. Copy of Labour, EPF & ESIC Registration Certificate must be uploaded along with the bid. A copy of the MSME Registration must be uploaded along with the bid. Bidder financial standing: The bidder should not be under liquidation; court receivership or similar proceed ings should not be bankrupt. Bidder to upload undertaking to this effect with bid. The firm should be registered with ISO 9001: 2015, 30414:2018, 30400:2022 Documentary evidence must

be uploaded with the bid. A copy of the income tax return for the last 3 years must be uploaded along with the bid. Copy of last 3 years turnover certificate certified by Chartered Accountant must be uploaded a long with th e bid. A copy of the last 3 Years' audited balance sheet must be uploaded along with the bid. It is mandatory for the bidder/firm to attach a self-declaration form (T-6) on stamp paper of Rs 100 /- along with the tender. Agency/Firm have to upload scanned copy of affidavit on stamp of Rs. 10/- regarding there is no dues of EP FO & ESIC department till date with bid at Gem portal. The agency/firm has to upload a scanned copy of Rs. 10/- Stamp paper regarding the Firm/Agency is not bl acklisted in any department of India with a bid at Gem Portal. The latest valid Solvency certificate of a minimum of Rs. 50 Lakh issued by the bank. It is mandatory for the service provider organization to attach a self-declaration letter along with the tende r form regarding whether or not to take benefits under the ABRY scheme. SOW undertaking must be uploaded. Copy of Last 6-month challans & transaction receipt of EPF & ESIC must be attached along with the bid. It is mandatory for the service provider organization to be registered under the Contract Labor Act, 1970. Copy of which is mandatory to be uploaded along with the tender. It is mandatory to submit original copy of all affidavits in the office before opening of tender. The tender will not be considered if the original copy of the affidavit is not submitted in the office. All affidavits should be after the tender publication date. Conditional tender will not be considered.

Bid having overwriting/ unreadable/suspensions/cutting/unreadable scanned copy would not be considered . The firm/Agency would be responsible if any worker got mishappening. The number of manpower will be purely need basis, therefore the number of workers deployed by the cont ractor is subject to increase or decrease depending on the requirement. It is mandatory to upload all the documents asked for in the tender, self-attested and stamped by the firm. Otherwise, the tender will not be considered. The buyer reserves the right to increase or decrease the quantity of manpower as per requirement during t he contract period. Bidders are bound to accept the orders accordingly. The contractor shall deploy medically and physically fit persons. The contract can be terminated by giving a prior one-month notice to the contractor. The bidder's offer is liable to be rejected if they don't upload any of the certificates/documents sought in th e Bid document, ATC, and Corrigendum if any. The right to accept/reject any tender without assigning any reason rests with the department. Conditional tender will not be accepted and will automatically be treated as canceled. The bidder's offer is liable to be rejected if they don't upload any of the certificates/documents sought in th e Bid document, ATC, and Corrigendum if any. All certificates should made before bud is published. Bidder should upload the salary structure of the employ on the company later head as given in ATC. 7. Payment PAYMENT OF SALARIES AND WAGES: Service Provider is required to pay Salaries / wages of contracted staff deployed at buyer location first i.e. on their own and then claim payment from Buyer alongwith all statutory documents like, PF, ESIC etc. as well as the bank statement of payment done to staff. 8.
